schemas.description: Institutional profile, campuses, departments, academic calendar, terms, and physical room assets.
Supertype person registry, student profiles, faculty records, and staff master data.
Application users, roles, permissions, audit trails, data requests, and session tokens.
Academic programmes, regulations, batches, sections, courses, units, topics, and outcomes (CO/PO).
Course offerings, student registrations, faculty allocations, timetables, lesson plans, class sessions, and syllabus coverage.
Class session attendance records, leave applications, daily tracking, and aggregated attendance summaries.
Assessment definitions, student question marks, component marks, internal marks, course results, term results, backlogs, and question papers.
Examination sessions, candidate seat allocations, invigilation duties, paper delivery tracking, and malpractice incidents.
Outcome-based education (OBE) attainment rubrics, calculation runs, CO attainment, and PO attainment traces.
Faculty and student publications, research grants, patents, citations, thesis tracking, and project supervision.
Institutional events, industry collaborations, MOUs, community outreach, and guest lectures.
Application intake, entrance rank verification, quota allocations, document verifications, and enrollment conversions.
Student fee structures, fee payments, dues tracking, scholarships, fee waivers, and institutional ledger heads.
Mentoring relationships, student grievances, clubs, sports achievements, and disciplinary cases.
Corporate partners, job openings, placement drive registrations, student offers, internship tracking, and alumni career paths.
Faculty workload allocations, performance appraisals, leave balances, professional development records, and payroll profiles.
Statutory bodies (BoS, Academic Council, Governing Body), policies, meeting minutes, and compliance circulars.
Internal Quality Assurance Cell (IQAC) KPI definitions, periodic measurements, accreditation metrics (NAAC/NBA/NIRF), and feedback surveys.
Institutional documentation, policy PDF chunking, embedding vectors, and RAG knowledge extraction.
Agent registry, tool definitions, execution runs, human reviews, safety flags, and fairness monitoring.
Medical accommodations, psychological counselling notes, and crisis escalation data. Strictly isolated.

rls_policies.using_expression: (identity.has_role('HOD') OR identity.has_role('DEAN') OR identity.has_role('IQAC'))     AND people.student_in_scope(student_id)
student_id = identity.current_student_id()     AND is_provisional = false OR published_at IS NOT NULL
(identity.has_role('HOD') OR identity.has_role('DEAN') OR identity.has_role('COE'))     AND people.student_in_scope(student_id)

(setter_faculty_id = identity.current_faculty_id()      OR moderator_faculty_id = identity.current_faculty_id())     AND (access_opens_at IS NULL OR now() >= access_opens_at)     AND (access_closes_at IS NULL OR now() <= access_closes_at)
identity.has_role('COUNSELLOR')     AND (counsellor_user_id = identity.current_user_id() OR counsellor_user_id IS NULL)
student_id IS NOT NULL AND studentlife.is_mentor_of(student_id)

(identity.has_role('HOD') OR identity.has_role('DEAN'))     AND flag_type <> 'WELLBEING_CONCERN'     AND routed_to_confidential = false     AND (student_id IS NULL OR people.student_in_scope(student_id))
